name: Heretic

origins.name: Loss
origins.description: This weapon gains bonus stability, handling, and aim assist whenever your shields are broken or when a friendly Guardian is defeated. Effect lasts until you are defeated.

perks.name: Supercharged Magazine
perks.description:
While amplified, ammo is gradually transferred from reserves to the magazine. 

While in Speed Booster, ammo regenerates faster and overflows the magazine.

enhanced.name: Supercharged Magazine
enhanced.description:
While amplified, ammo is gradually transferred from reserves to the magazine.

While in Speed Booster, ammo regenerates faster and overflows the magazine. Improves magazine size.

perks.name: Rolling Storm
perks.description:
Final blows grant Bolt Charge.
While amplified, final blows grant additional Bolt Charge.

enhanced.name: Rolling Storm
enhanced.description:
Final blows grant Bolt Charge.
While amplified, final blows grant additional Bolt Charge. 
Gain increased Bolt Charge stacks when you have none.

perks.name: Impulse Amplifier
perks.description: Massively increases projectile velocity, increases reload speed.

enhanced.name: Impulse Amplifier
enhanced.description: Massively increases projectile velocity, substantially increases reload speed.

perks.name: Demolitionist
perks.description: Kills with this weapon generate grenade energy. Activating your grenade ability reloads this weapon from reserves.

enhanced.name: Demolitionist
enhanced.description: Final blows with this weapon generate an improved amount of grenade energy. Activating your grenade ability reloads this weapon from reserves.

perks.name: Cluster Bomb
perks.description: Rockets spawn cluster bombs upon detonation.

enhanced.name: Cluster Bomb
enhanced.description: Rockets spawn cluster bombs upon detonation. Blast radius is increased.

perks.name: Envious Arsenal
perks.description: Dealing damage with both other weapons before readying this weapon refills it from reserves.

enhanced.name: Envious Arsenal
enhanced.description: Dealing damage with both other weapons before readying this weapon refills it from reserves. Increases ammo generation.

perks.name: Impromptu Ammunition
perks.description: Final blows increase ammo meter progress from all sources for a short time.

enhanced.name: Impromptu Ammunition
enhanced.description: Final blows increase ammo meter progress from all sources for a slightly increased duration.

perks.name: Gear Shift
perks.description: Reloading after a final blow or becoming amplified grants a period of increased damage. Stacks 5x.

enhanced.name: Gear Shift
enhanced.description: Reloading after a final blow or becoming amplified grants a longer period of increased damage. Stacks 5x.

perks.name: Voltshot
perks.description: Reloading this weapon after defeating a target overcharges this weapon for a short period of time, causing it to jolt on its next hit.

enhanced.name: Voltshot
enhanced.description: Reloading this weapon after defeating a target overcharges this weapon for an improved short period of time, causing it to jolt on its next hit.

perks.name: Explosive Light
perks.description: Picking up an Orb of Power increases the next projectile's blast radius and damage.

enhanced.name: Explosive Light
enhanced.description: Picking up an Orb of Power increases the next projectile's blast radius and damage. Increases the stack count limit.

perks.name: Bipod
perks.description: Increases ammo and reserves but reduces damage, blast radius, and reload speed.

enhanced.name: Bipod
enhanced.description: Increases ammo and reserves but reduces damage. Blast radius and reload speed are slightly reduced.

perks.name: Frenzy
perks.description: Being in combat for an extended time increases damage, handling, and reload for this weapon until you are out of combat.

enhanced.name: Frenzy
enhanced.description: Being in combat for an extended time increases damage, handling, and reload for this weapon for an improved duration until you are out of combat.

perks.name: Adrenaline Junkie
perks.description: This weapon gains increased damage and handling from final blows with grenades or this weapon.

enhanced.name: Adrenaline Junkie
enhanced.description: This weapon gains increased damage and handling from final blows with grenades or this weapon for an improved duration.

perks.name: Binary Orbit
perks.description: Elemental final blows opposite this weapon increase damage for a short duration. Darkness final blows boost Arc, Solar, and Void weapons. Light final blows boost Stasis, Strand, and Kinetic weapons.

enhanced.name: Binary Orbit
enhanced.description: Elemental final blows opposite this weapon increase damage for an improved duration. Darkness final blows boost Arc, Solar, and Void weapons. Light final blows boost Stasis, Strand, and Kinetic weapons.

flavor: "Death is only and forever an ending. All else is sacrilege." —Kuldax
